title: Card Game
description: 1 captured save. One original BASIC player; historical bugs remain.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: CARD GAME
versions.note: validated payload. 45 consistent BASIC line pointers; normal end marker; byte-identical with left-hp800; not execution-tested
versions.startupSource:
5 DEFINT A-Z
10 P=4:DIM C$(13),P$(P),H$(P,4),R(P),L(P)
20 FOR I=1TO13:C$(I)=STR$(I):NEXTI
30 C$(11)="10":C$(12)="10":C$(13)="NN":C$(4)="SM":C$(9)="RV":C$(10)="MT"
50 P$(1)="NN OT RV SM MT BLIZTKREIG"
60 P$(2)="OT MT NN SM RV NICE GUY"
70 P$(3)="OT NN SM RV MT SAMES BEFORE REV."
80 P$(4)="OT NN RV SM MT REV.S BEFORE SAME"
90 'P$(5)="MT RV SM RO NN DUMB S"
200 CLS
210 FOR I=1TOP:PRINT@I*64,"PLAYER #"I" - "RIGHT$(P$(I),LEN(P$(I))-15);": ";LEFT$(P$(I),15);
220 NEXT I

attribution.text: Original author and any earlier published source have not been established. Preserved here as recovered cassette material.
